recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31788 unless BR&R later requests a purely editorial parent-element wording change; the conformance-significant repeatability, jurisdiction, and missing-jurisdiction semantics are already present.
issue_request: FHIR-31788 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the R4 MedicinalProductPackaged ballot comment asking whose legalStatusOfSupply and marketingStatus assertions applied. The accepted change was to make LegalStatusOfSupply a 0..* backbone element, add an optional jurisdiction element, state that a missing jurisdiction means the jurisdiction is unknown in context, and extend the description around regulatory jurisdiction.
initial_application: The current R5 source lineage uses PackagedProductDefinition for the former MedicinalProductPackaged area. Git history shows 920f713f5930dd8a4fd5510818b7abccfb7816e4 made legalStatusOfSupply a backbone for FHIR#31788, f9c5f6282fc5b3e90732c9ac59ce7ebae16bed4d temporarily removed it during nearby packaged-product edits, 08d35148dd0fa3866502882e1805fe34cb107da4 restored it with jurisdiction, and 70072108591e64757c33bbb8806f88b31302f48a corrected the backbone cardinality to 0..* despite a FHIR#1788 subject typo.
additional_context: PackagedProductDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini maps the old MedicinalProductPackaged name toward the newer packaged product definition family. The active MarketingStatus datatype already includes country and jurisdiction fields, so PackagedProductDefinition.marketingStatus inherits the needed locality semantics through that datatype. BR&R WGM minutes noted FHIR-31788 had already been applied. A later same-family core issue, FHIR-36049, proposed mirroring the repeatable legal-status pattern onto MedicinalProductDefinition but was withdrawn with no change, so it does not expand this audit's source scope.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current PackagedProductDefinition.legalStatusOfSupply is 0..*, typed as BackboneElement, has a code child and a jurisdiction child, and the jurisdiction definition says that when it is not specified the jurisdiction is unknown in this context. Current MarketingStatus source has country and jurisdiction elements describing where marketing status applies.

related_jiras.note: Later withdrawn no-change request to mirror the same repeatable legal-status/jurisdiction pattern onto MedicinalProductDefinition; it confirms no broader core resource edit is required for FHIR-31788.
